# Feature: Info tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #58 (Info tile) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: teaches the next mechanic in one line. Unique: the only tile whose job is teaching, not blocking. Useful: introduces a mechanic inside the level that needs it. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** teaches the next mechanic in one line.

**So that** introduces a mechanic inside the level that needs it.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Info tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-58-info-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: an info tile beside a chain of switches, written with the order on it. A player who steps over it without reading, because it does not block anything, presses the switches in the order they reach them and resets the chain, which teaches that a tile can be in a level to be read rather than to be crossed. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping on the marked tile shows a one-line banner teaching the next mechanic in the level and does nothing else
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It triggers once per tile and never blocks movement

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It triggers once per tile and never blocks movement
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Info tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-58-info-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #58.
